detail.title: Operational Frameworks for Objective Records
detail.summary: Objective physical records emerge through the redundant broadcast of pointer states into the environment, a process that enables multiple independent observers to access consistent information without disturbing the source system. This objective character is grounded in the stability of pointer states under decoherence.
detail.reason: Sufficient distinct source works were retrieved to synthesize a stable operational framework for objective records, satisfying the notebook requirements.
